fields.spatialConcept: 具有美术馆气质的专业医美商业接待主厅：完整前台、成组候客与主厅边缘一处半开放皮肤/美学咨询工作位共同组织开阔空间；一组与侧向建筑连接、局部向上部延伸的珠光半透明弧形界面参与候客与咨询边界，完整主曲面、少量辅助薄层和结构留白形成可辨艺术语言；暖白米白基底、局部浅木与柔和暖日光保持真实材料层次。
fields.structureLanguage:
接待主厅：以完整实体墙、入口建筑框景、可读顶面和开敞横向通行组织前台、成组候客及边缘专业咨询节点。
接待主厅：一组珠光半透明弧形建筑构件从侧向建筑界面局部衔接上部边界，沿候客边缘向半开放咨询节点有方向地延伸并轻薄收束；起止明确的完整主曲面与少量错层辅助薄层形成层间深度和透景留白，大部分顶面与墙体仍完整可读。
接待主厅：曲面薄边、错层透射与轻微珍珠母贝内反射共同建立珠光艺术特征；近景退让，中央和横向视线开敞，前台服务面、候客组团及咨询设备可辨。
接待主厅：半开放皮肤/美学咨询节点位于大厅边缘，以珠光曲面局部界定边界，开口透见专业咨询台面、设备与顾客面对面就坐关系；后续私密服务入口由错位实体界面屏蔽。
fields.lightingLanguage:
温暖、柔和、均匀的漫射自然日光
少量克制的暖调建筑间接光
fields.functionalProgram:
入口到达与清楚的分流区
正式接待与员工工作区
成组候客与短时交流区
主厅边缘一处半开放皮肤/美学专业咨询工作位
通向私密服务的受屏蔽过渡边界
fields.mustAvoid:
巨型羽毛、花瓣、涡旋或密集重复薄片从近景墙面横扫天花
包围全画面的旋转装置与双侧近景巨片夹击
以中央独立雕塑或抢眼悬吊艺术灯替代建筑组织
艺术馆中孤立摆放一张前台、空泛无功能展示大厅或角落零散小椅子
前台服务面被遮挡、候客面积被装饰挤压、完全隐藏后续服务分区
密集诊室门排、狭长中轴走廊与极端超广角畸变
冷白偏蓝、全场过曝、紫色家具与紫色舞台灯带
重复波浪灯槽、厚重不透明花瓣团块与无依据的施工尺寸
fields.lightingContrast: 暖白建筑、浅木质和中性软包具有可辨的温和明暗层次，半透明界面保留柔和透射与边缘细节
fields.lightingInteraction:
漫射自然光温暖地照亮前台、候客与半开放服务分区，家具和地面呈宽缓柔和阴影
浅木质保留自然纹理与暖色反射，暖白墙面、软包和透光界面彼此可区分
局部珠光随自然光产生很弱的内层虹彩，适度曝光保持表面体积、透景和薄边细节
fields.lightingAvoid:
冷白偏蓝的整体照明与玻璃发灰
过曝抹平浅色材料层次
紫色灯带、舞台照明与高饱和发光装置
强直射光、硬阴影和抢夺空间焦点的独立雕塑灯具
fields.colorAvoid:
紫色扩散到家具、软包、窗帘或大面积建筑表面
冷白偏蓝的单一色场与浅色材料层次消失
fields.functionalNetwork:
Reception: arrival reveals the complete visitor-facing reception counter and a clear approach, with a usable staff work surface and staff access behind it for check-in and appointment service.
Reception: the complete counter and grouped waiting area connect laterally across the open hall, with generous circulation rather than a narrow central corridor.
Reception: one complete sofa and armchair group faces small tables for sitting and conversation, with space to approach, sit and circulate around the group, understandable without people.
Reception: visitors move from reception or grouped waiting to one semi-open skin/aesthetic consultation workstation at the hall edge; a professional consultation worktop, one compact skin imaging analysis or consultation display device, consultant seating and an opposite guest seat establish a readable face-to-face service relationship; staff access remains clear.
fields.functionalRelationships:
Reception and grouped waiting remain visually connected across the open lateral hall; gaps in the local integrated pearlescent curved boundary reveal the skin/aesthetic consultation worktop, display device and face-to-face seating relationship.
Reception: an offset solid return beyond the semi-open consultation workstation screens onward private care access; treatment activity, care beds and private room interiors remain off frame.
fields.visibleRequirements:
A complete, reachable reception counter with an appropriately weighted visitor service face, a usable staff work surface and a small amount of real office equipment, integrated into the hall rather than hidden in a corner
One complete sofa and armchair waiting group with small tables, usable seating and conversation space, warm neutral upholstery and light timber details, with circulation clear around it
One semi-open skin/aesthetic consultation workstation at the hall edge: a professional consultation worktop with one compact skin imaging analysis or consultation display device and opposing consultant and guest seating; the display shows only abstract non-identifiable skin-analysis visualization or a simple image layout, without readable random text, diagnostic text, metrics, medical records, treatment promises or personal information; private care stays screened
A clear entrance arrival zone, lateral counter-to-waiting circulation and a readable onward route, with real building surfaces and open foreground sightlines
One local architectural pearlescent translucent curved system connected to the side building interface and locally to the upper boundary, with a complete directional main curve, a few offset thin auxiliary layers, fine edges, depth and visible structural gaps; it defines waiting and consultation edges while leaving most ceiling and walls readable
One small flat clean unlettered identity surface on an architectural interface, outside the main circulation and unobstructed; small operational carriers remain subordinate to the complete functional areas
fields.artisticFocus:
接待区：核心艺术语言是一组与侧向建筑及局部上部边界连续衔接的珠光半透明弧形建筑构件，沿候客与咨询边缘有起止地展开，以完整主曲面、少量辅助薄层、薄边和错层深度形成精致而疏朗的层间节奏。
接待区：透景留白与轻微珍珠母贝内反射使曲面区别于普通无色玻璃屏风；局部弱紫只在材料内层出现。艺术构件同时参与功能分隔，保留完整实体建筑、前台、候客及咨询设施视线，不以独立雕塑建立焦点。
fields.compositionRequirements:
从入口斜向观察完整主接待厅：完整来访服务面及员工工作关系、成组候客、主厅边缘一处专业皮肤/美学咨询工作位与横向通行均清楚可读；设备与面对面座位可感知，不沿狭长走廊收束。
珠光曲面从侧向建筑局部连接上部边界，主曲面和少量错层辅助薄层界定候客及咨询边缘，薄边、层间深度和透景留白可辨；左右近景退让，大部分安静顶面和实体墙体仍可读。
冲突排序为可辨专业医美服务功能及开阔可信的商业建筑空间优先，其次建筑一体化精致珠光艺术语言，再次暖光与材料平衡，最后零散商业道具；通过退让与疏朗分层协调艺术与功能。
成组沙发、扶手椅及轻桌可坐、可等候、可绕行，不形成临窗茶席主景；正常建筑摄影透视、可信人体尺度，错位实体界面屏蔽私密服务转场。

args.sourceStatement: 2026-10-19 用户授权：按本轮附件在新隔离测试副本恢复建筑一体化珠光曲面语言，并增加一处半开放皮肤/美学专业咨询工作位；保留暖光、完整前台、成组候客及隐私边界。三张附件图仅供设计分析，不登记为素材或发送给模型。不新增展示龛、治疗设备、人物、施工尺寸或可读医疗文字。不修改正式项目、历史副本、生产代码、Golden或人工验收。仅正式网页编辑保存确认、离线标准零参考请求预演与必要回归，真实生图与付费校验均为0，完成后停止待用户审核。

fields.functionalNetwork:
Reception: arrival reveals the complete visitor-facing reception counter and a clear approach, with a usable staff work surface and staff access behind it for check-in and appointment service.
Reception: the complete counter and grouped waiting area connect laterally across the open hall, with generous circulation rather than a narrow central corridor.
Reception: one complete sofa and armchair group faces small tables for sitting and conversation, with space to approach, sit and circulate around the group, understandable without people.
Reception: visitors move from reception or grouped waiting to one semi-open skin/aesthetic advisory workstation at the hall edge; a professional advisory worktop, one compact skin imaging analysis or advisory display device, consultant seating and an opposite guest seat establish a readable face-to-face service relationship; staff access remains clear.
fields.functionalRelationships:
Reception and grouped waiting remain visually connected across the open lateral hall; gaps in the local integrated pearlescent curved boundary reveal the skin/aesthetic advisory worktop, display device and face-to-face seating relationship.
Reception: an offset solid return beyond the semi-open advisory workstation screens onward private care access; treatment activity and care beds and private room interiors remain off frame.
fields.visibleRequirements:
A complete, reachable reception counter with an appropriately weighted visitor service face, a usable staff work surface and a small amount of real office equipment, integrated into the hall rather than hidden in a corner
One complete sofa and armchair waiting group with small tables, usable seating and conversation space, warm neutral upholstery and light timber details, with circulation clear around it
One semi-open skin/aesthetic advisory workstation at the hall edge: a professional advisory worktop with one compact skin imaging analysis or advisory display device and opposing consultant and guest seating; the display shows only abstract non-identifiable skin-analysis visualization or a simple image layout, without readable random text, diagnostic text, metrics, medical records, care outcome promises or personal information; private care stays screened
A clear entrance arrival zone, lateral counter-to-waiting circulation and a readable onward route, with real building surfaces and open foreground sightlines
One local architectural pearlescent translucent curved system connected to the side building interface and locally to the upper boundary, with a complete directional main curve, a few offset thin auxiliary layers, fine edges, depth and visible structural gaps; it defines waiting and advisory edges while leaving most ceiling and walls readable
One small flat clean unlettered identity surface on an architectural interface, outside the main circulation and unobstructed; small operational carriers remain subordinate to the complete functional areas
fields.artisticFocus:
接待区：核心艺术语言是一组与侧向建筑及局部上部边界连续衔接的珠光半透明弧形建筑构件，沿候客与面询边缘有起止地展开，以完整主曲面、少量辅助薄层、薄边和错层深度形成精致而疏朗的层间节奏。
接待区：透景留白与轻微珍珠母贝内反射使曲面区别于普通无色玻璃屏风；局部弱紫只在材料内层出现。艺术构件同时参与功能分隔，保留完整实体建筑、前台、候客及面询设施视线，不以独立雕塑建立焦点。
fields.compositionRequirements:
从入口斜向观察完整主接待厅：完整来访服务面及员工工作关系、成组候客、主厅边缘一处专业皮肤/美学面询工作位与横向通行均清楚可读；设备与面对面座位可感知，不沿狭长走廊收束。
珠光曲面从侧向建筑局部连接上部边界，主曲面和少量错层辅助薄层界定候客及面询边缘，薄边、层间深度和透景留白可辨；左右近景退让，大部分安静顶面和实体墙体仍可读。
冲突排序为可辨专业医美服务功能及开阔可信的商业建筑空间优先，其次建筑一体化精致珠光艺术语言，再次暖光与材料平衡，最后零散商业道具；通过退让与疏朗分层协调艺术与功能。
成组沙发、扶手椅及轻桌可坐、可等候、可绕行，不形成临窗茶席主景；正常建筑摄影透视、可信人体尺度，错位实体界面屏蔽私密服务转场。

args.sourceStatement: 2026-10-19 用户授权：按本轮附件在新隔离测试副本恢复建筑一体化珠光曲面语言，并增加一处半开放皮肤/美学专业咨询工作位；保留暖光、完整前台、成组候客及隐私边界。三张附件图仅供设计分析，不登记为素材或发送给模型。不新增展示龛、治疗设备、人物、施工尺寸或可读医疗文字。不修改正式项目、历史副本、生产代码、Golden或人工验收。仅正式网页编辑保存确认、离线标准零参考请求预演与必要回归，真实生图与付费校验均为0，完成后停止待用户审核。
